metadata.title: JODHPUR  Food Tour | Part - 1/2 I Rajasthan Food Tour
metadata.description:
Delhi Food Walks went on a street food tour covering some of the lesser known street delicacies in Jodhpur. In Jodhpur, I was joined by Dr Navneet, Asst. Professor by profession and food enthusiast by passion. He took us on a full-on street food tour in the old town of Jodhpur. 

We tried some of the lesser known dishes of Jodhpur like malai ki roti, kabuli, gulabjamun ki sabzi, mishri goonja etc. Watch this video till end to experience the street food of Jodhpur with Delhi Food Walks.

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
